# AuthorLoft

> Your Books. Your Readers. Your Business. — The complete platform for independent authors to own their business, sell books directly, grow their audience, and track everything — no coding required.

AuthorLoft helps independent authors take control of their careers by providing a complete platform for building an author website, selling books directly to readers (keeping 100% of every sale), capturing newsletter subscribers, and tracking reader analytics.

## Key Facts
- Website: https://www.authorloft.com
- Type: SaaS platform for independent authors
- Pricing: Free to start, Standard ($19.99/mo), Premium ($79.99/mo)
- No credit card required to start

## Core Features
- **Direct Sales**: Sell ebooks directly to readers on every plan (including free) — upgrade for print, audio, and flipbook formats
- **Author Website Builder**: Custom-domain author sites with book pages, blog, about page, and contact — no coding required
- **Reader Analytics**: PostHog-powered analytics to understand your audience
- **Newsletter Capture**: Built-in subscriber forms and email tools (Mailchimp integration)
- **Bookstore Discovery**: Shared catalog at authorloft.com/bookstore where readers discover indie authors by genre
- **AI Tools**: AI writing assistant, social media post generator, SEO auditor, and reader feedback analyzer (powered by Gemini)
- **Pre-orders & Affiliate Program**: Accept pre-orders and run an affiliate referral program
- **Flip Books**: Interactive page-flip book previews
- **Media Kit**: Auto-generated press kit PDF for author marketing
